source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 5 (PDF 130-142), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Enzymes) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Enzymes are also known as:
(Enzymes ko aur kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes khaas proteins hain jo khud badle baghair reactions tez karte hain; inhen biocatalysts bhi kehte hain (5.1).

book_ref.quote: Enzymes are also known as biocatalysts

blocks.prompt:
2 Rates of enzyme-catalysed reactions may be greater than those of uncatalysed reactions by:
(Enzyme wale reactions ki raftaar baghair enzyme ke reactions se kitni guna zyada ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enzyme wale reactions ki raftaar baghair enzyme ke reactions se 10³ se 10⁸ guna zyada ho sakti hai (5.1).

book_ref.quote: Rates of enzyme-catalysed reactions may be 10³ to 10⁸ times greater

blocks.prompt:
3 All enzymes are synthesized inside cells by:
(Tamam enzymes cell ke andar kis ke zariye bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam enzymes cell ke andar ribosomes banate hain; phir woh andar kaam karte hain ya bahar bheje jate hain (5.1).

book_ref.quote: All enzymes are synthesized inside cells by ribosomes

blocks.prompt:
4 The enzymes of glycolysis are found:
(Glycolysis ke enzymes kahan paye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se enzymes, jaise glycolysis ke, cytoplasm mein hal hote hain (5.1).

book_ref.quote: Inside cell, many enzymes are dissolved in cytoplasm; for example, the enzymes of glycolysis

blocks.prompt:
5 The enzymes of protein synthesis are:
(Protein synthesis ke enzymes kahan hote hain?)

options.text: cell se bahar bheje jate hain

blocks.explanation: Kuch enzymes, jaise protein synthesis ke, ribosomes ka lazmi hissa hain (5.1).

book_ref.quote: Some enzymes are integral part of ribosomes; for example, the enzymes of protein synthesis

blocks.prompt:
6 A reaction completed in 30 minutes with an enzyme would take, without the enzyme, about:
(Jo reaction enzyme ke saath 30 minute mein mukammal ho, enzyme ke baghair taqreeban kitna waqt lega?)
blocks.explanation: Enzyme ke saath 30 minute wala reaction enzyme ke baghair aik saal leta (5.1).

book_ref.quote: would take one year to get completed without being catalysed by enzyme

blocks.prompt:
7 The reactions in red blood cells differ from those in nerve cells because these cells:
(Red blood cells aur nerve cells ke reactions mukhtalif kyun hain?)

options.text: un mein enzymes ke mukhtalif set hain
aik jaise enzymes mukhtalif pH par
enzymes sirf cell ke bahar istemal karte hain

blocks.explanation: Tamam cells mein aik jaise enzymes nahi; red blood cells aur nerve cells mein enzymes ke mukhtalif set hain (5.1).

book_ref.quote: red blood cells and nerve cells contain different sets of enzymes

blocks.prompt:
8 The small cleft on the surface of an enzyme, made of a few amino acids, where catalysis occurs, is the:
(Enzyme ki satah par chhota gadha jo chand amino acids se bana aur jahan catalysis hoti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Active site globular enzyme ki satah par chand amino acids ka chhota gadha hai jahan catalysis hoti hai (Active Site).

book_ref.quote: This site is known as active site

blocks.prompt:
9 The substrate fits into the binding site of the active site by:
(Substrate active site ke binding site mein kis cheez se fit hota hai?)

options.text: kamzor chemical quwwaten jaise hydrogen bonds

blocks.explanation: Substrate binding site mein kamzor chemical quwwaton jaise hydrogen bonds se fit hota hai; phir catalytic site reaction karata hai (Active Site).

book_ref.quote: Substrate molecule fits into binding site by weak chemical forces

blocks.prompt:
10 The two distinct regions of an active site are:
(Active site ke do alag hisse kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Active site ke do hisse hain: binding site (substrate ko pakarta hai) aur catalytic site (use products mein badalta hai) (Active Site).

book_ref.quote: Active site has two distinct regions i.e., binding site and catalytic site

blocks.prompt:
11 Pepsin is produced in an inactive form called:
(Pepsin kis ghair fa'al shakal mein banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pepsin apne banane wale cells ke protein structures tabah kar sakta hai, is liye ghair fa'al pepsinogen banta hai aur apni jagah par fa'al hota hai (Active Site).

book_ref.quote: That is why it is produced in inactive form (pepsinogen)

blocks.prompt:
12 Chemically, enzymes are:
(Kimiyai tor par enzymes kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes teen jihati globular proteins hain jo apne oopar lipti polypeptide chains se bane hain (Active Site).

book_ref.quote: Enzymes are three-dimensional globular proteins

blocks.prompt:
13 How many kinds of cofactors are described?
(Cofactors ki kitni qismen bayan ki gayi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cofactors ki teen qismen hain: metal ions, prosthetic groups aur coenzymes (5.2).

book_ref.quote: There are three kinds of cofactor: metal ions, prosthetic groups, and coenzymes

blocks.prompt:
14 The protein part of an enzyme is called the:
(Enzyme ka protein hissa kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Protein hissa apoenzyme hai; cofactor samait mukammal enzyme holoenzyme hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: The protein part of enzyme is called apoenzyme

blocks.prompt:
15 Apoenzyme + cofactor =
(Apoenzyme + cofactor =)
blocks.explanation: Cofactor samait mukammal enzyme holoenzyme kehlata hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: complete enzyme including co-factor is called holoenzyme

blocks.prompt:
16 Metal ion cofactors act by:
(Metal ion cofactors kaise kaam karte hain?)

options.text: ghair fa'al active sites ko fa'al banana
enzymes ke darmiyan electrons le jana

blocks.explanation: Metal ions ghair fa'al active sites ko fa'al banate hain; is se enzyme ki shakal badal kar substrate se milne ke qabil hoti hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: These metal ions change the non-functional active sites of enzymes into functional sites

blocks.prompt:
17 Hematin is an example of a:
(Hematin kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jo cofactors enzyme se covalent bonds banayen woh prosthetic groups hain; aik organic misaal hematin hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Some cofactors form covalent bonds with enzyme and are known as prosthetic groups

blocks.prompt:
18 Which vitamins are named as functioning as coenzymes?
(Kaun se vitamins coenzymes ka kaam karte bataye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se vitamins, jaise niacin aur riboflavin, coenzymes ka kaam karte hain; kuch coenzymes ka hissa hain (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Many vitamins (e.g., niacin and riboflavin) function as coenzymes

blocks.prompt:
19 When NAD⁺ acquires a hydrogen atom, it is reduced to:
(Jab NAD⁺ hydrogen atom hasil karta hai to kis mein reduce hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: NAD⁺, sab se ahem coenzyme, hydrogen acceptor hai; hydrogen atom lene par NADH ban jata hai jo electron ki energy uthata hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: When NAD⁺ acquires a hydrogen atom from an enzyme, it reduces to NADH

blocks.prompt:
20 A non-protein organic cofactor loosely attached to the enzyme is a:
(Enzyme se dheela juda ghair protein organic cofactor kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dheela juda ghair protein organic cofactor coenzyme hai; covalent bond wala prosthetic group hai (5.2).

book_ref.quote: When the cofactor is a non-protein organic molecule and is loosely attached with enzyme

blocks.prompt:
21 Trace elements used by enzymes as cofactors include:
(Woh trace elements jo enzymes cofactors ke taur par istemal karte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Molybdenum aur manganese jaise trace elements jo sehat ke liye zaroori hain, enzymes cofactors ke taur par istemal karte hain (5.2).

book_ref.quote: Many trace elements such as molybdenum and manganese

blocks.prompt:
22 The speed of a chemical reaction depends on the amount of:
(Chemical reaction ki raftaar kis ki miqdaar par munhasir hai?)

options.text: shuru karne ke liye zaroori activation energy

blocks.explanation: Reaction ki raftaar us activation energy par munhasir hai jo use shuru karne ke liye chahiye; enzymes ise kam karte hain (5.3).

book_ref.quote: Activation energy is the energy which works to destabilize existing chemical bonds

blocks.prompt:
23 The presence of an enzyme affects a reaction by:
(Enzyme ki mojoodgi reaction par kya asar daalti hai?)

options.text: reaction mein khatam ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Enzymes products ki nau'iyat ya khususiyaat nahi badalte: sucrose hamesha glucose aur fructose deta hai, sucrase ho ya na ho (5.3).

book_ref.quote: sucrose (substrate) will always be hydrolysed into glucose and fructose

blocks.prompt:
24 When the substrate binds with the active site, the structure formed is the:
(Jab substrate active site se judta hai to kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Substrate active site se jud kar ES complex banata hai aur catalytic site fa'al ho jati hai (5.3).

book_ref.quote: an enzyme-substrate complex (ES complex) is formed and catalytic site is activated

blocks.prompt:
25 After the products are formed, the enzyme:
(Products banne ke baad enzyme ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: product ka hissa ban jata hai
bina badle alag ho kar dobara kaam karta hai

blocks.explanation: Reaction ke baad enzyme bina badle products se alag ho jata hai: E + S → ES → E + P (5.3).

book_ref.quote: enzyme detaches itself from the products, in an unaltered state

blocks.prompt:
26 In a metabolic pathway, the product of one enzyme's catalysis:
(Metabolic pathway mein aik enzyme ke amal ka product kya karta hai?)

options.text: agle enzyme ko tabah karta hai
foran cell se nikal jata hai
agle enzyme ka substrate banta hai

blocks.explanation: Respiration aur photosynthesis jaise pathways mein enzymes silsilewar kaam karte hain; aik ka product agle ka substrate banta hai (5.3).

book_ref.quote: The successive enzymes controlling these steps are present together along with their cofactors

blocks.prompt:
27 The lock-and-key model was proposed in 1894 by:
(Lock-and-key model 1894 mein kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: German chemist Emil Fischer ne 1894 mein lock-and-key model pesh kiya (Models).

book_ref.quote: In 1894 a German chemist Emil Fischer proposed lock-and-key model

blocks.prompt:
28 The induced fit model was presented by Daniel Koshland in:
(Daniel Koshland ne induced fit model kis saal pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: American biochemist Daniel Koshland ne 1958 mein induced fit model pesh kiya (Models).

book_ref.quote: an American biochemist Daniel Koshland (1958) presented induced fit model

blocks.prompt:
29 According to the lock-and-key model, the active site is:
(Lock-and-key model ke mutabiq active site kaisi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lock-and-key model ke mutabiq active site sakht hai aur amal se pehle, dauran ya baad mein koi tabdeeli nahi (Models).

book_ref.quote: This model postulates that active site is a rigid structure

blocks.prompt:
30 In the induced fit model, binding of the substrate:
(Induced fit model mein substrate ka judna kya karta hai?)

options.text: active site ko sakht karta hai
enzyme ki banawat mein tabdeeli lata hai

blocks.explanation: Induced fit model mein substrate ka judna enzyme ki banawat mein tabdeeli lata hai jis se woh behtar catalysis karta hai (Models).

book_ref.quote: it induces changes in enzyme structure

blocks.text: 5.4 Factors affecting the rate of enzyme action

blocks.prompt:
31 Enzyme activity is affected by any change that alters the enzyme's:
(Enzyme ki activity har us tabdeeli se mutasir hoti hai jo enzyme ki ... badle:)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes mahol ke bare hassas hain; un ki chemistry aur teen jihati shakal badalne wali har tabdeeli activity par asar daalti hai (5.4).

book_ref.quote: The activity of an enzyme is affected by any change that alters its chemistry and its three-dimensional shape

blocks.prompt:
32 The optimum temperature for human enzymes is:
(Insani enzymes ka optimum temperature kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har enzyme apne optimum temperature par sab se tez kaam karta hai; insani enzymes ke liye 37 °C (Temperature).

book_ref.quote: The optimum temperature for human enzymes is 37 °C

blocks.prompt:
33 The shape of an enzyme protein is held by:
(Enzyme protein ki shakal kin cheezon se qaim rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic interactions polypeptide chains ko jagah par rakhte hain; temperature ki thori tabdeeli bhi inhen tor deti hai (Temperature).

book_ref.quote: Both the hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions are easily disrupted by slight changes in temperature

blocks.prompt:
34 Loss of the globular structure of an enzyme at a temperature well above optimum is called:
(Optimum se bohat zyada temperature par enzyme ki globular banawat khatam hona kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shadeed thartharahat se polypeptide chains ke bonds toot jate hain aur globular banawat khatam: denaturation (Temperature).

book_ref.quote: This phenomenon is known as denaturation of enzyme

blocks.prompt:
35 Below the optimum temperature, the reaction rate is slow because:
(Optimum se kam temperature par reaction kyun dheema hota hai?)

options.text: bonds kam lachakdaar ho kar active site mein induced tabdeeli nahi hone dete

blocks.explanation: Optimum se kam par bonds kam lachakdaar ho jate hain aur active site mein zaroori induced tabdeeli nahi hone dete (Temperature).

book_ref.quote: the bonds that determine enzymes shape become less flexible

blocks.prompt:
36 Thermophilic bacteria of hot springs have enzymes that can function at:
(Garam chashmon ke thermophilic bacteria ke enzymes kis temperature par kaam kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Thermophilic bacteria ke proteins mein mazboot bonding hai aur woh 70 °C ya zyada par kaam karte hain (Temperature).

book_ref.quote: can function at temperature of 70 °C or higher

blocks.prompt:
37 A rise in temperature up to a limit increases reaction rate because heat:
(Aik had tak temperature barhne se reaction tez kyun hota hai?)

options.text: kinetic energy deti hai, molecules zyada takraate hain

blocks.explanation: Garmi activation energy mein izafa karti aur kinetic energy deti hai, is liye molecules tez chal kar zyada takraate hain (Temperature).

book_ref.quote: Heat also provides kinetic energy to substrate and enzyme molecules

blocks.prompt:
38 Which enzyme shows its optimum activity in an alkaline medium?
(Kaun sa enzyme alkaline medium mein behtareen kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pepsin tezabi medium (kam pH) mein fa'al hai; trypsin alkaline medium (zyada pH) mein behtareen kaam karta hai (pH).

book_ref.quote: pepsin is active in acidic medium (low pH) while trypsin shows its optimum activity in alkaline medium

blocks.prompt:
39 An enzyme that works in both acidic and alkaline media is:
(Woh enzyme jo tezabi aur alkaline dono medium mein kaam kare:)
blocks.explanation: Kachche papite ka papain tezabi aur alkaline dono medium mein kaam karta hai (pH).

book_ref.quote: Some enzymes like papain from green papaya work both in acidic and alkaline media

blocks.prompt:
40 In globular enzymes, pH-sensitive bonds are formed between oppositely charged amino acids such as:
(Globular enzymes mein pH se mutasir hone wale bonds mukhalif charge wale amino acids mein bante hain, jaise:)
blocks.explanation: Polypeptide chains mukhalif charge wale amino acids jaise glutamic acid (–) aur lysine (+) ke bonds se judi hain jo H⁺ ki miqdaar se mutasir hote hain (pH).

book_ref.quote: such as glutamic acid (-) and lysine (+)

blocks.prompt:
41 An extreme change in pH results in:
(pH mein intehai tabdeeli ka nateeja kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: pH ki intehai tabdeeli enzyme ke bonds tor kar denaturation kar deti hai (pH).

book_ref.quote: Extreme change in pH can break the bonds in enzymes, resulting in enzyme denaturation

blocks.prompt:
42 The optimum pH of pancreatic lipase is:
(Pancreatic lipase ka optimum pH kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table ke mutabiq pancreatic lipase 8.0 (Figure 5.6 ki correction: pepsin ki choti 1.6 aur lipase ki 8 par) (pH).

book_ref.quote: The peaks are drawn at 1.6 and 8 above

blocks.prompt:
43 The optimum pH of pepsin is:
(Pepsin ka optimum pH kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pepsin ka optimum pH 1.5–1.6 hai (kitab ka table; Figure 5.6 durust) (pH).

book_ref.quote: against the book's own table of optimum pH (pepsin 1.5-1.6, pancreatic lipase 8.0)

blocks.prompt:
44 A change in pH affects enzyme activity mainly by changing:
(pH ki tabdeeli enzyme ki activity par zyada tar kis cheez ko badal kar asar daalti hai?)

options.text: active site ke amino acids (aur substrate) ki ionization

blocks.explanation: pH ki tabdeeli active site ke amino acids ki ionization aur substrate ki ionization bhi badal sakti hai (pH).

book_ref.quote: Any change in pH can change the ionization of amino acids at active site

blocks.prompt:
45 Enzymes are very efficient because:
(Enzymes bohat kaar-aamad kyun hain?)

options.text: thore enzyme molecules bohat substrate par kaam karte hain

blocks.explanation: Thore se enzyme molecules bohat zyada substrate par kaam kar sakte hain (Enzyme Concentration).

book_ref.quote: a small number of enzyme molecules can catalyse reactions of large amount of substrate

blocks.prompt:
46 With unlimited substrate, increasing enzyme concentration increases the rate because:
(Substrate la-mehdood ho to enzyme barhane se raftaar kyun barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada enzyme molecules ka matlab zyada active sites, is liye zyada substrate jud kar badalta hai (Enzyme Concentration).

book_ref.quote: When enzyme concentration increases, there are more enzyme molecules and more active sites

blocks.prompt:
47 If enzyme concentration keeps increasing while substrate concentration stays the same, the rate of reaction:
(Agar enzyme barhta rahe aur substrate wohi rahe to reaction ki raftaar:)
blocks.explanation: Substrate muqarrar ho to izafi enzymes se aur substrate nahi judta, is liye raftaar yaksan rehti hai (Enzyme Concentration).

book_ref.quote: the rate of reaction stays constant and does not increase further

blocks.prompt:
48 At high substrate concentration the rate of reaction does not increase further because:
(Zyada substrate par reaction ki raftaar mazeed kyun nahi barhti?)

options.text: substrate baghair enzyme product ban jata hai
tamam active sites bhari hoti hain

blocks.explanation: Zyada substrate par tamam active sites bhari hoti hain; izafi substrate ko khaali jagah nahi milti (Substrate Concentration).

book_ref.quote: when all active sites of enzymes are occupied (at high substrate concentration)

blocks.prompt:
49 An increase in substrate concentration increases the reaction rate only when:
(Substrate barhane se raftaar sirf tab barhti hai jab:)

options.text: enzymes ki active sites khaali hon

blocks.explanation: Agar enzymes ki active sites khaali hon to zyada substrate se raftaar barhti hai (Substrate Concentration).

book_ref.quote: If there are enzyme molecules with vacant active sites

blocks.prompt:
50 A chemical that interferes with and blocks an enzyme's activity is called a(n):
(Jo chemical enzyme ki activity mein mudakhlat kar ke use rok de:)
blocks.explanation: Inhibitor enzyme se judta hai magar product nahi banta, aur active sites ko aarzi ya mustaqil band karta hai (5.6).

book_ref.quote: A chemical that interferes and blocks an enzyme

blocks.prompt:
51 Aspirin suppresses pain and inflammation by inhibiting the enzymes that produce:
(Aspirin dard aur sozish kin enzymes ko rok kar kam karti hai? Jo banate hain:)
blocks.explanation: Aspirin un enzymes ko rokti hai jo prostaglandin banate hain (jo sozish karta hai) (5.6).

book_ref.quote: It inhibits the enzymes that produce prostaglandin

blocks.prompt:
52 Cyanide blocks cellular respiration by combining with copper and iron in the active site of:
(Cyanide kis enzyme ke active site mein copper aur iron se jud kar cellular respiration rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyanide irreversible inhibitor hai jo cytochrome oxidase ke active site mein copper aur iron se judta hai (5.6).

book_ref.quote: combines with copper and iron in the active site of enzyme cytochrome oxidase

blocks.prompt:
53 A competitive inhibitor resembles the:
(Competitive inhibitor kis se mushabeh hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Competitive inhibitor substrate se mushabeh hota hai aur usi binding site ke liye muqabla karta hai (book correction) (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: A competitive inhibitor resembles the substrate, not the enzyme

blocks.prompt:
54 Succinic dehydrogenase oxidizes succinic acid into:
(Succinic dehydrogenase succinic acid ko kis mein oxidize karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Succinic dehydrogenase succinic acid ko fumaric acid mein oxidize karta hai (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: The enzyme succinic dehydrogenase catalyses the oxidation of succinic acid to fumaric acid

blocks.prompt:
55 Malonic acid inhibits succinic dehydrogenase because it:
(Malonic acid succinic dehydrogenase ko kyun rokta hai?)

options.text: doosri jagah jud kar shakal badalta hai
succinic acid se mushabeh hai aur active site ke liye muqabla karta hai
enzyme se covalent bonds banata hai
garmi se enzyme denature karta hai

blocks.explanation: Malonic acid succinic acid se mushabeh hai, active site ke liye muqabla kar ke use band karta hai: competitive inhibition (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: Malonic acid has structural similarity with substrate (succinic acid)

blocks.prompt:
56 In the formation of succinyl-CoA by succinyl-CoA synthetase, the product succinyl-CoA acts as a:
(Succinyl-CoA synthetase se succinyl-CoA banne mein product succinyl-CoA kya kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Succinyl-CoA non-competitive inhibitor ban kar enzyme se judta hai aur mazeed succinyl-CoA nahi banta (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: the product i.e., succinyl CoA acts as a non-competitive inhibitor

blocks.prompt:
57 Irreversible inhibitors bind with the enzyme by:
(Irreversible inhibitors enzyme se kis bond se judte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Irreversible inhibitors covalent bonds banate hain; dilution, dialysis ya zyada substrate se alag nahi hote (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: Irreversible inhibitors make covalent bonds with enzyme

blocks.prompt:
58 Penicillin permanently disables the bacterial enzyme responsible for:
(Penicillin bacteria ke kis kaam wale enzyme ko mustaqil nakara karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin irreversible inhibitor hai jo bacteria ki cell wall banane wale enzyme ko mustaqil nakara karti hai (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: penicillin permanently disables the enzyme responsible for building bacterial cell walls

blocks.prompt:
59 Malonate is an example of a(n):
(Malonate kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reversible inhibitors kamzor bonds banate hain; malonate succinate dehydrogenase ko aarzi rokta hai aur hatane par asar khatam ho jata hai (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: Reversible inhibitors make weak bonds (e.g., hydrogen bonds) with enzyme

blocks.prompt:
60 A non-competitive inhibitor:
(Non-competitive inhibitor:)

options.text: active site ke ilawa doosri jagah judta hai

blocks.explanation: Non-competitive inhibitor substrate se mushabeh nahi, active site mein nahi jata balke doosri jagah jud kar enzyme ki shakal badalta hai (Types of Inhibitors).

book_ref.quote: A non-competitive inhibitor has no real structural similarity to substrate

blocks.prompt:
61 In feedback inhibition, the inhibitor is the:
(Feedback inhibition mein inhibitor kaun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Feedback inhibition mein aakhri product shuru ke enzyme se jud kar us ki shakal badalta aur pathway band karta hai (Feedback Inhibition).

book_ref.quote: The final product of pathway acts as inhibitor

blocks.prompt:
62 When a cell has more ATP than it needs, ATP:
(Jab cell mein zaroorat se zyada ATP ho to ATP kya karta hai?)

options.text: ATP banane wale enzyme ko rokta hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada ATP non-competitive inhibitor ban kar ATP banane wale enzyme ko rok deta hai (Feedback Inhibition).

book_ref.quote: ATP itself acts as a non-competitive inhibitor

blocks.prompt:
63 Inhibitors of enzymes involved in blood clotting are used as:
(Khoon jamne wale enzymes ke inhibitors kis taur par istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khoon jamne ke kuch enzymes ke inhibitors anticoagulants ke taur par istemal hote hain (Significance of Enzyme Inhibition).

book_ref.quote: some inhibitors of enzymes involved in blood clotting are used as anticoagulants

blocks.prompt:
64 Cancer drugs may act by inhibiting enzymes involved in:
(Cancer ki dawaiyan kin enzymes ko rok kar kaam kar sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat si dawaiyan inhibitors hain: antibiotics bacteria ke enzymes rokti hain; cancer ki dawaiyan cell division ke enzymes rok sakti hain (Significance).

book_ref.quote: cancer drugs may inhibit enzymes involved in cell division

blocks.prompt:
65 Enzymes are classified on the basis of:
(Enzymes ki classification kis bunyad par hoti hai?)

options.text: karaye gaye reactions aur istemal hone wale substrates

blocks.explanation: Enzymes un reactions ki bunyad par jo woh karate hain aur un substrates ki bunyad par jo woh istemal karte hain, classify hote hain (5.7).

book_ref.quote: Enzymes are classified on the basis of reactions they catalyse and also on the basis of substrates they use

blocks.prompt:
66 On the basis of the general type of reaction, enzymes are classified into:
(Reaction ki aam qisam ki bunyad par enzymes kitni classes mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction ki aam qisam ke mutabiq enzymes chhe classes mein hain (Classification on Reactions).

book_ref.quote: enzymes are classified into six classes

blocks.prompt:
67 Hexokinase, which transfers a phosphate group from ATP to glucose, is a(n):
(Hexokinase jo ATP se glucose ko phosphate group deta hai, kis class ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transferases aik substrate se doosre ko functional group (methyl, acyl, amino, phosphate) dete hain, jaise hexokinase (Classification on Reactions).

book_ref.quote: hexokinase transfers phosphate group from ATP to glucose

blocks.prompt:
68 Pyruvate decarboxylase, which removes CO₂ from pyruvic acid, belongs to:
(Pyruvate decarboxylase jo pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikalta hai, kis class mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lyases baghair paani ke groups jaise CO₂ aur NH₂ jorte ya nikalte hain, jaise pyruvate decarboxylase (Classification on Reactions).

book_ref.quote: pyruvate decarboxylase removes CO₂ from pyruvic acid

blocks.prompt:
69 The enzyme class that converts one isomer into another, e.g. glucose into fructose, is:
(Woh class jo aik isomer ko doosre mein badle, jaise glucose ko fructose mein:)
blocks.explanation: Isomerases molecule ke andar tarteeb badalte hain; hexose isomerase glucose ko fructose banata hai (Classification on Reactions).

book_ref.quote: hexose isomerase converts glucose to fructose

blocks.prompt:
70 Enzymes that add or remove H⁺ ions or electrons from substrates, such as cytochrome oxidase, are:
(Woh enzymes jo substrates se H⁺ ions ya electrons jorte ya nikalte hain, jaise cytochrome oxidase:)
blocks.explanation: Oxidoreductases H⁺ ions ya electrons jor kar ya nikal kar oxidation/reduction karte hain, jaise cytochrome oxidase (Classification on Reactions).
